newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Bausch sinks, GM off a bit.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Bausch sinks, GM off a bit.

text.p: Shares of Bausch & Lomb Inc sunk lower in preopening trading after the eyecare company said it expected continuing softness in its sunglasses business to hurt its fourth quarter earnigs.

Shares sunk to 32-1/2, off from the stock's closing price on the New York Stock Exchange on Wednesday of 36, traders said. Bausch & Lomb said its fourth quarter earnings were hurt by continuing softness in sunglasses including order cancellations from its largest customer Sunglass Hut International Inc.
Shares of General Motors Corp also moved lower ahead of the opening of trading, off one to 53-1/2 from its close last night of 54-1/2.
The automaker, which is a Dow component, told analysts it expects fourth quarter earnings to disappoint analysts because of higher incentives and advertising costs for new products.
The company said it is expecting fourth quarter earnings of about $0.60 compared with consensus estimates of about $1.
